remarks: 25 Tokeneke Trail - Where the Sky meets the Sea. Wake up to breathtaking sunrises, spend afternoons on the water, and end each day with sunset views from your private terrace. 25 Tokeneke Trail isn't just a home-it's a lifestyle. Perfectly perched above the shoreline and not in a flood zone, this stunning waterfront retreat offers direct access to the water with its own private beach and dock. Designed for seamless indoor-outdoor living, nearly every room frames panoramic water views. Multiple stone terraces, a firepit, and lush landscaping create the perfect setting for entertaining or quiet relaxation. Inside, over 6,000 sq. ft. of refined living space includes five bedrooms, seven baths, and a private studio suite over the detached garage ideal for a guest house or private retreat. Minutes from downtown Darien and the train to NYC, this rare property blends the serenity of coastal living with the best of modern luxury.
